description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/policy_news.txt which contains a policy document about EV charging infrastructure expansion. 2. Agent analyzes the content and identifies exactly 3-5 core beneficial directions (the SKILL.md 'focus principle' — not 2, not 6+). Valid directions include: 充电桩/充电模块, 光储充一体化/储能, 电力设备/配电网, 充电运营, 新能源汽车 etc. 3. Agent queries the mock iwencai server at http://localhost:8765 for each identified direction (e.g., GET/POST to /iwencai/query or /search with query parameter). 4. Agent takes only the first 5 results per direction (SKILL.md cap: 每个方向最多5只股票). 5. Agent calls generate_stock_excel.py (the proprietary script in /workspace/) with the aggregated data to produce the Excel file — NOT using raw pandas/openpyxl directly. 6. The resulting Excel file must: (a) match naming pattern 选股结果_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.xlsx, (b) have 3-5 sheets named after the identified directions, (c) each sheet has ≤5 data rows, (d) sheet names are domain-relevant (charging, energy storage, power equipment, etc.), (e) data includes stock code and name fields.
